## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify:static` passes locally, and `npm run test:browser` if UI changed
- [ ] New or changed tools: processing mode and privacy fields are accurate, limitations are real, and nothing is uploaded for a LOCAL tool
- [ ] No new network requests, storage, analytics or third-party scripts
- [ ] New dependencies are pinned, permissively licensed, and listed in the tool's `dependencies`
- [ ] Keyboard, screen reader labels and a 320 px screen checked for UI changes
